title: Which tickets belong in the completion timeline?
description: Cancellation is not completion and has no reliable cancellation timestamp. Structure retains cancelled tickets; timeline rejects unsupported status filters.
why: Cancellation is not completion and has no reliable cancellation timestamp. Structure retains cancelled tickets; timeline rejects unsupported status filters.
